supportingSources.label: Atari Superman operation and service manual

strategy.summary: Repeat the left spinner from the right flipper, complete lanes 1-2-3-4 for 3x Bonus, then shoot center drops only when their return is safe or few SUPERMAN letters remain.

quickInfo.name: Lit spinners
quickInfo.summary: A slingshot hit lights one spinner for 1,000 per spin, and later slingshot hits change the lit spinner.

quickInfo.name: Left spinner
quickInfo.summary: The left spinner is the preferred repeatable shot because its top lane also adds 5,000 points.

quickInfo.name: Bonus X
quickInfo.summary: Complete top lanes 1-2-3 for 2x Bonus, then add lane 4 for 3x Bonus.

quickInfo.name: SUPERMAN
quickInfo.summary: Five standups and three return lanes spell SUPERMAN for 30,000 or 50,000 points, based on the switch setting.

quickInfo.name: Drop bank and saucer
quickInfo.summary: One drop-bank completion raises the upper-left saucer from 5,000 to 10,000, and a second completion can light Extra Ball.

steps.text: Plunge for top lane 4. Then check which spinner the first slingshot hit lights.
Move the ball to the right flipper. Shoot the left spinner even when the other spinner is lit.
Use the top feed to complete lanes 1-2-3 for 2x Bonus. Add lane 4 for 3x Bonus.
Repeat the left spinner while its return remains controlled. Use lit-spinner periods for the best value.
Shoot a lit center drop only if its rebound avoids the right outlane. Stop after an unsafe return.
Complete SUPERMAN only when one or two standups remain and their shots are controlled.

fallback.title: Top lanes and bonus
fallback.when: Use this when spinner returns are fast or the right flipper cannot make the left spinner.

steps.text: Send the ball to the top through the safer available lane.
Use lanes, rollovers, and incidental drops to build base bonus toward 29,000.

alternatives.title: Drop bank and saucer
alternatives.when: Use this when center-drop rebounds are safe on this machine.

steps.text: Time each drop shot for the target that is lit for 5,000.
Complete the five-bank once to raise the upper-left saucer to 10,000.
Take the saucer when its kickout is controlled.
Do not chase the second bank when Extra Ball is disabled or the rebound becomes unsafe.
Score lanes, star rollovers, and drop targets until base bonus reaches 29,000.
Repeat the left spinner during its lit periods.
Take SUPERMAN only when the remaining standups are safe.

techniques.name: Lane-4 skill shot
techniques.instruction: Adjust the plunge to collect lane 4. This lane is required for 3x Bonus and is easiest from the plunge.

techniques.name: Lit-spinner selection
techniques.instruction: Watch the slingshots. Each hit changes which spinner is lit, so wait for the useful spinner when control permits it.

cautions.issue: Center-drop rebounds often move toward the right outlane.
cautions.response: Test one controlled shot. Return to the spinners if the rebound reaches the outlane area.

cautions.issue: Balls that return through the right spinner can become uncontrolled.
cautions.response: Watch the complete feed before you repeat that spinner. Prefer the left spinner when its return is safer.

cautions.issue: The upper-left saucer kickout can change with machine setup.
cautions.response: Observe one kickout before you use the saucer as a repeatable scoring shot.

strategy.simpleOverview: Superman uses lanes 1-2-3-4 for 3x Bonus and slingshot hits to move a 1,000-per-spin lamp between two spinners. Complete the lanes, repeat the left spinner when it is lit, and shoot SUPERMAN standups only when the remaining letters have safe returns.
strategy.overview: Superman uses lanes 1-2-3-4 for 3x Bonus and slingshot hits to move a 1,000-per-spin lamp between two spinners. Complete 1-2-3-4 and build the base toward 29,000, then favor the lit left spinner from the right flipper. Use the center standups only for a short, controlled finish to SUPERMAN and avoid repeated drop-bank rebounds.
